description.zh: 面向企业员工的场景化工作助手。组合专家、技能、插件、MCP/Connector 与定时任务，支持运维巡检、故障报告、技术调研、培训材料和进度跟踪。
description.en: A scenario-based work assistant for enterprise employees. Combines experts, skills, plugins, MCP/connectors, and scheduled tasks for operations checks, incident reports, research, training materials, and progress tracking.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你要完成的工作，或描述一个可重复执行的场景；我会先明确系统、数据范围、执行权限和结果去向。
welcome_message.en: Tell me what work you need done or describe a repeatable scenario. I will first clarify systems, data scope, permissions, and where results should go.

description.zh: 把重复工作整理成可复用的步骤、工具和验收结果
description.en: Turn recurring work into reusable steps, tools, and acceptance criteria

prompt.zh:
帮我把下面的工作整理成一个可复用场景：明确触发条件、输入、执行步骤、需要的工具/连接器、权限与审批边界、结果模板、通知对象和失败处理。不要假设尚未配置的系统或凭据。

工作描述：
prompt.en:
Turn this work into a reusable scenario: define its trigger, inputs, steps, required tools/connectors, permission and approval boundaries, output template, recipients, and failure handling. Do not assume systems or credentials that have not been configured.

Work description:

description.zh: 读取已授权设备状态，分析异常并生成巡检报告
description.en: Read authorized equipment status, analyze anomalies, and create an inspection report

prompt.zh: 按已配置的设备巡检场景执行一次只读巡检。逐项列出数据来源、检查时间、指标与阈值、异常证据和未能检查的项目；生成报告草稿。只有在通知目标已配置且允许自动发送时才发送通知，不执行修复或重启。
prompt.en: Run one read-only inspection using the configured equipment scenario. List each data source, check time, metric and threshold, evidence, and anything not checked; create a report draft. Send a notification only when its destination is configured and auto-send is allowed. Do not remediate or restart systems.

description.zh: 整理现象、证据、影响范围、原因判断和待办
description.en: Organize symptoms, evidence, impact, findings, and follow-up actions

prompt.zh: 基于已提供或已授权读取的记录生成故障报告。区分已证实事实、推测和未知项，附上证据来源、影响范围、时间线、临时措施建议及后续责任人待确认项；不要编造数据或直接修改生产系统。
prompt.en: Prepare an incident report from provided records or authorized read access. Separate verified facts, hypotheses, and unknowns; include evidence sources, impact, timeline, suggested mitigations, and follow-ups whose owners need confirmation. Do not invent data or change production systems.

description.zh: 围绕技术主题整理有来源的讲解和 PPT 大纲
description.en: Create a sourced explanation and presentation outline for a technical topic

prompt.zh: 围绕我指定的技术主题做调研，优先使用官方或一手资料，标出来源和发布日期，区分事实与建议，并输出适合内部培训的 PPT 大纲（目标受众、学习目标、逐页标题与要点、演示练习、参考资料）。
prompt.en: Research the technical topic I specify, prioritizing official and primary sources. Cite sources and publication dates, separate facts from recommendations, and produce an internal training deck outline with audience, objectives, slide titles and points, hands-on exercise, and references.

zh: 每个工作日 09:00，使用已配置的只读巡检连接检查指定应用服务器的 CPU、内存、磁盘、关键服务和最近错误日志，生成带证据的巡检报告；异常时按已配置的企业微信通知策略发送，禁止自动修复。
每周五 16:00，汇总指定项目空间中本周已完成、进行中、阻塞和逾期事项，附来源链接与负责人；缺少权限或数据时明确列出，不推测进度。
每月第一个工作日 10:00，对已登记且获批的资产执行漏洞扫描器的安全基线/温和扫描，汇总风险、受影响资产和证据；不得扩大目标范围、执行利用或自动修复，发现高危项时按已配置的通知策略上报。
en: Every workday at 09:00, use configured read-only inspection connectors to check CPU, memory, disk, critical services, and recent error logs on the specified application servers. Create an evidence-based report and notify through the configured WeCom policy on anomalies. Do not remediate automatically.

Every Friday at 16:00, summarize completed, in-progress, blocked, and overdue items from the specified project space, with source links and owners. Explicitly list inaccessible or missing data; do not infer progress.

At 10:00 on the first business day of each month, run a security-baseline or gentle scan through the configured scanner against registered, approved assets. Summarize risk, affected assets, and evidence. Do not expand scope, exploit findings, or remediate automatically; report high-risk findings through the configured notification policy.
